examples.arabic: الناس كانت كتير في السوق وكلهم بيضحكوا.
examples.english: People were many in the market and all of them were laughing.
examples.transliteration: El nas kanet ketir fel soo2 we kollhom beyed7akou.

examples.arabic: على طول، ولاد الحتة بيروحوا يساعدوا الناس اللي محتاجة.
examples.english: Immediately, the neighborhood boys go to help people who are in need.
examples.transliteration: 3ala tool, welad el 7etta beyroo7u yesa3edu el nas elly me7taga.

examples.arabic: عمل الخير بيفرح الناس وبيقرب القلوب.
examples.english: Doing good makes people happy and brings hearts closer.
examples.transliteration: 3amal el kheir beyefarra7 el nas we bey2arrab el 2oloob.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: الناس كانت كتير في السوق وكلهم بيضحكوا.
examples.english: People were many in the market and all of them were laughing.
examples.transliteration: El nas kanet ketir fel soo2 we kollhom beyed7akou.

examples.arabic: على طول، ولاد الحتة بيروحوا يساعدوا الناس اللي محتاجة.
examples.english: Immediately, the neighborhood boys go to help people who are in need.

examples.english: Doing good makes people happy and brings hearts closer.
examples.transliteration: 3amal el kheir beyefarra7 el nas we bey2arrab el 2oloob.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: هو كان شخص كويس اوي وساعدني والحمد لله وصلت بالسلامة
examples.english: He was a very good person and helped me and thank God I arrived safely.
examples.transliteration: Howa kan shakhs kwayes awi we saadni wel hamdullelah wasalt bel salama

examples.arabic: بعدين رجعوا بيتهم الجميل مبسوطين جداً.
examples.english: Then they returned to their beautiful house, very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein reg'ou beithom el gamil mabsootein geddan.

examples.arabic: الجو كان جميل أوي الصبح في حتتنا.
examples.english: The weather was very beautiful this morning in our neighborhood.
examples.transliteration: El gaw kan gameel awi el sobh fi 7atetna.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: السوق كان جميل أوي وفيه ناس كتير.
examples.english: The market was very beautiful and had many people.
examples.transliteration: El sooq kan gamil awi w fih nas ktir.

examples.arabic: ليلى كانت بنت صغيرة وجميلة أوي.
examples.english: Layla was a very small and beautiful girl.
examples.transliteration: Layla kanet bent soghayara we gamila awi.

examples.arabic: البنت بتسأل هو انتي رايحة الشغل دلوقتي
examples.english: The girl asks: Are you going to work now?
examples.transliteration: El-bent betsa'al: Howa enti rayḥa esh-shoġl dilwa'ti?

examples.arabic: بنت و ولد صغيرين قاعدين معاهم تليفونات
examples.english: A young girl and boy are sitting with their phones.
examples.transliteration: Bint w walad soghayyareen qa3deen ma3ahom teleefonaat.

examples.arabic: بابا بيقول إن الموضوع محتاج حكم كويس زي حكم القضاء
examples.english: My dad says the matter needs good judgment like the judgment of the judiciary.
examples.transliteration: Bābā biyʾūl en el-mawḍūʿ meḥtāg ḥokm kowayyes zayy ḥokm el-qaḍāʾ.

examples.arabic: يوسف: الحمد لله، أنا كويس. وإنت عامل إيه؟
examples.english: Youssef: Praise be to God, I'm good. And how are you doing?
examples.transliteration: Youssef: Elhamdulillah, ana kwayyes. We enta 3amel eh?

examples.arabic: ماما بتجيب أكل كويس أوي لغدانا.
examples.english: Mom brings very good food for our lunch.
examples.transliteration: Mama bitgeeb akl kwayis awi lighadana.
examples.storyTitle: War News on the Day of Eid

examples.arabic: كل يوم بنصحى بدري عشان نخطط للفرح الكبير
examples.english: Every day we wake up early to plan for the big wedding.
examples.transliteration: Koll yōm bansaa badry ʿashān nokhaṭṭeṭ lel-faraḥ el-kabīr.

examples.arabic: ركبوا العربية بتاعتهم وراحوا السوق الكبير في القاهرة.
examples.english: They got into their car and went to the big market in Cairo.
examples.transliteration: Rakbou el 3arabeya beta3ethom we rahou el soo2 el kebir fi el Qahera.

examples.arabic: أحمد راح السوق الكبير في القاهرة امبارح.
examples.english: Ahmed went to the big market in Cairo yesterday.
examples.transliteration: Ahmed rah el sooq el kebir fel Qahera embareh.

examples.arabic: العم محمود كان راجل طيب.
examples.english: Uncle Mahmoud was a good man.
examples.transliteration: El 3am Ma7moud kan ragel tayeb.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: بعدين، راحوا عند عم محمود يسألوه.
examples.english: Then, they went to Uncle Mahmoud to ask him.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein, ra7o 3and 3amm Mahmoud yes'aluh.
examples.storyTitle: A Beautiful Day in Our Neighborhood

examples.arabic: فجاة شفت صاحبي القديم محمود قدام المخبز
examples.english: Suddenly I saw my old friend Mahmoud in front of the bakery.
examples.transliteration: Fagaa shoft sahby el adeem Mahmoud oddam el makhbaz.

examples.arabic: اه معايا عايز اغيره بواحد اكبر
examples.english: Yes I have it, I want to exchange it for a bigger one.
examples.transliteration: ah ma3aya 3ayez aghayyaroh bewahed akbar

examples.arabic: يوسف: نادي الزمالك، صاحبي عنده ماتش كورة هناك.
examples.english: Youssef: Zamalek club, my friend has a football match there.
examples.transliteration: Youssef: Nady el Zamalek, sahby 3ando match kora henak.

examples.arabic: السلام عليكم يا صاحبي عامل ايه النهارده
examples.english: Peace be upon you my friend, how are you doing today?
examples.transliteration: As salamu alaykum ya sahbi amel eh ennaharda
examples.storyTitle: A New Day with the Family

examples.arabic: بكرة، صاحبي أحمد هيشتري خمس أقلام وعشر كراسات.
examples.english: Tomorrow, my friend Ahmed will buy five pens and ten notebooks.
examples.transliteration: Bokra, sahby Ahmed hayeshtry khamas aqlam wa ashar korasat.
examples.storyTitle: A Day at the New School

examples.arabic: العم محمود كان راجل طيب.
examples.english: Uncle Mahmoud was a good man.
examples.transliteration: El 3am Ma7moud kan ragel tayeb.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: هناك، الراجل بيبيع خضار طازة وبيقول: 'كام كيلو عايزة يا ست الكل؟' وأنا بقول له: 'عايزة كيلو بطاطس و اتنين كيلو طماطم من عندك'.
examples.english: There, the man sells fresh vegetables and says: 'How many kilos do you want, madam?' And I tell him: 'I want one kilo of potatoes and two kilos of tomatoes from you.'
examples.transliteration: Honak, el ragel byebaaʾ khoḍar taza w byeqool: 'Kam kilo ʾayza ya sitt el kol?' W ana baqoolloh: 'ʾAyza kilo batates w etnein kilo tamatem men ʾandak'.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: شفت راجل بيشتغل في محل وقلت له السلام عليكم
examples.english: I saw a man who works in a shop and I said to him peace be upon you.
examples.transliteration: Shoft ragel biyeshtaghal fe mahal we olteloh as salamu alaykum

examples.arabic: بياع الفُل، اللي كان شايل حلة كبيرة، ابتسم وقال بصوت عالي: صباح الخير يا ست البنات! تحبي تاكلي فُل سخن؟
examples.english: The ful vendor, who was carrying a large pot, smiled and said loudly: "Good morning, lady of all girls! Would you like to eat hot ful?"
examples.transliteration: Bayya3 el-ful, elly kan shayel 7ella kebira, ebtesem w 'al be-sout 3ali: "Sabah el-kheir ya sett el-banat! Te7ebbi takli ful sokhn?"
examples.storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: إخواته البنات بيحبوا العيش المصري أوي.
examples.english: His sisters love Egyptian bread very much.
examples.transliteration: Ekhwato el banat beyhebu el eish el masri awi.

examples.arabic: هما كانوا لابسين تيشيرتات حمراء بتاعة المنتخب المصري.
examples.english: They were wearing red shirts belonging to the Egyptian national team.
examples.transliteration: Homa kano labsin t-shirtat hamra beta'et el montakhab el masry.

examples.arabic: هناك، الراجل بيبيع خضار طازة وبيقول: 'كام كيلو عايزة يا ست الكل؟' وأنا بقول له: 'عايزة كيلو بطاطس و اتنين كيلو طماطم من عندك'.
examples.english: There, the man sells fresh vegetables and says: 'How many kilos do you want, madam?' And I tell him: 'I want one kilo of potatoes and two kilos of tomatoes from you.'
examples.transliteration: Honak, el ragel byebaaʾ khoḍar taza w byeqool: 'Kam kilo ʾayza ya sitt el kol?' W ana baqoolloh: 'ʾAyza kilo batates w etnein kilo tamatem men ʾandak'.
examples.storyTitle: An Egyptian Morning: Coffee, Music, and the Market

examples.arabic: الراجل بيقول البيت جنب الجامع الكبير
examples.english: The man says the house is next to the big mosque.
examples.transliteration: el ragel beyeool el beit ganb el gameaa el kebeer

examples.arabic: انا رحت المحل وشفت الراجل اللي بيشتغل هناك
examples.english: I went to the shop and saw the man who works there.
examples.transliteration: ana roht el mahal we shoft el ragel elly biyeshtaghal henak

examples.arabic: الكل استمتع باللمة الحلوة وقررنا مش هنبقى سايبين بعض قريب
examples.english: Everyone enjoyed the lovely gathering, and we decided we wouldn't be leaving each other soon.
examples.transliteration: El kol estamta' bel lamma el helwa we qarrarna mesh hanebqa saybeen ba'd qareeb

examples.arabic: الكل جاهز للمتعة والوقت الحلو
examples.english: Everyone is ready for fun and a nice time!
examples.transliteration: El-koll gahez lel-mot3a w el-waqt el-7elw.

examples.arabic: لما قعدنا ناكل الكل عجبته الاكلة الجديدة
examples.english: When we sat to eat, everyone liked the new dish.
examples.transliteration: Lamma qa'adna nakol el-kol 'agabto el-akla el-gedeeda.

examples.arabic: بنتهم نورا بتحب ترسم صور جميلة.
examples.english: Their daughter, Nora, loves to draw beautiful pictures.
examples.transliteration: Bentehom Nora bethebb tersom sowar gamila.

examples.arabic: في السوق، شافوا فواكه وخضروات بألوان كتير جميلة.
examples.english: In the market, they saw many fruits and vegetables with beautiful colors.
examples.transliteration: Fel soo2, shafou fawakeh we khodarwat be alwan ketir gamila.

examples.arabic: كان فيه بيت صغير في حارة جميلة.
examples.english: There was a small house in a beautiful alley.
examples.transliteration: Kan fih beit soghayar fi 7ara gamila.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: البياع اللي اسمه عم حسن، راجل كبير كده، لاحظ إنها زعلانة شوية.
examples.english: The vendor, whose name was Uncle Hassan, an older man, noticed that she was a bit sad.
examples.transliteration: El-bayya3 elly esmo 3amm Hassan, ragel kebir kida, lahezh enaha za3lana shwaya.
examples.storyTitle: Mona and the Ataba Market Book

examples.arabic: فيه طفل صغير اسمه كريم
examples.english: There is a small child, his name is Karim.
examples.transliteration: Feh tefl soghayar esmo Karim.

examples.arabic: اسمه احمد
examples.english: His name is Ahmed.
examples.transliteration: ismu aHmad

examples.arabic: فجأة، اللاعب المصري جاب جون، وكل الناس صرخوا من الفرحة.
examples.english: Suddenly, the Egyptian player scored a goal, and all the people screamed from joy.
examples.transliteration: Fagaa, el la'eb el masry gab gon, wa kol el nas sarakho mel farha.

examples.arabic: وفجأة لاعب من الفريق الازرق جاب جون عالمي والتشجيع زاد
examples.english: Suddenly, a player from the blue team scored an amazing goal and the cheering increased.
examples.transliteration: Wi faga'a la'eb min el fareeq el azraq gab goon 'alamy wal tashgee' zad

examples.arabic: لاعب جاب جون حلو اوي
examples.english: A player scored a very nice goal.
examples.transliteration: La'eb gab goon helw awy

examples.arabic: صاحب المحل قال آسف يا فندم
examples.english: The shop owner said: Sorry, sir.
examples.transliteration: Sa7eb elma7al 'al: Asif ya fanadem.

examples.arabic: طلع إن القطة كان عندها ميعاد مع صاحب الكلب
examples.english: It turned out that the cat had an appointment with the dog's owner!
examples.transliteration: Tala' en el 'oTTa kan 'andaha me'aad ma' SaHeb el kalb
examples.storyTitle: A Visit to the Local Market

examples.arabic: صاحب المحل كان طيب جدا وقالي مفيش مشكلة واداني غيره
examples.english: The shop owner was very kind and told me "no problem", and gave me new ones.
examples.transliteration: Saheb el mahal kan tayeb geddan we ali mafish moshkela we eddani gheero

examples.arabic: قطتها اسمها "مشمش" ولونها أبيض زي الثلج.
examples.english: Her cat's name is "Meshmesh" and its color is white like snow.
examples.transliteration: Ottetha esmaha "Meshmesh" we lonha abyad zay el talg.

examples.arabic: كل بنات العيلة بيساعدوا
examples.english: All the girls in the family are helping.
examples.transliteration: Kol banat el-3eila beyza3doo.

examples.arabic: بعد الحصة قابلوا المدرسة وقالت اهلا وسهلا يا بنات
examples.english: After class, they met the teacher, and she said "Welcome, girls."
examples.transliteration: Ba'd el-hessa abelo el-modarresa w alet ahlan wa sahlan ya banat.

examples.arabic: بياع الفُل، اللي كان شايل حلة كبيرة، ابتسم وقال بصوت عالي: صباح الخير يا ست البنات! تحبي تاكلي فُل سخن؟
examples.english: The ful vendor, who was carrying a large pot, smiled and said loudly: "Good morning, lady of all girls! Would you like to eat hot ful?"
examples.transliteration: Bayya3 el-ful, elly kan shayel 7ella kebira, ebtesem w 'al be-sout 3ali: "Sabah el-kheir ya sett el-banat! Te7ebbi takli ful sokhn?"
examples.storyTitle: Greetings in the Bustle of Khan el-Khalili

examples.arabic: طبعاً يا بنتي، خليهم. الشاي بتاعنا مشهور، يبقى عظيم وبنقترحه.
examples.english: Of course, my daughter, keep them. Our tea is famous, it will be great, and we recommend it.
examples.transliteration: Tab'an ya benti, khalleehom. Esh-shay beta'na mashhoor, yeb'a 3azeem waben'tare7o.

examples.arabic: خليهم يلعبوا على البحر براحتهم و يبقى يوم عظيم لينا كلنا
examples.english: Let them play on the beach freely, and it will be a great day for all of us.
examples.transliteration: Khaleehom yel3abo 3al ba7r bara7ethom w yeb2a yom 3azeem leena kollena.

examples.arabic: عمر فرح وقال: عظيم يا عم، متشكرين خالص، مع السلامة!
examples.english: Omar was happy and said: 'Great, uncle, thanks a lot, goodbye!'
examples.transliteration: Omar faraḥ wi 'al: '3azeem ya 3amm, mitshakkerin khalis, ma3 es-salama!'

examples.arabic: قلت له ان الشباب دلوقتي بتحب تلبس الوان كتير في الرياضة
examples.english: I told him that the youth nowadays love to wear many colors in sports.
examples.transliteration: olt loh en el shabab delwaaty betheb telbes alwaan keteer fi el reyada

examples.arabic: لكن الشباب كانوا عايزين اغاني جديدة ويرقصوا
examples.english: But the youth wanted new songs and to dance.
examples.transliteration: Laken el shabab kanu ayzin aghani gedida w yor'osu.

examples.arabic: الشباب عايزين اتنين او تلاته اماكن جديدة فيها بحر او العاب
examples.english: The youth want two or three new places with a beach or games.
examples.transliteration: El shabab ayzeen etneen aw talata amaken gedida feeha bahr aw al'ab.

examples.arabic: بعدين رجعوا بيتهم الجميل مبسوطين جداً.
examples.english: Then they returned to their beautiful house, very happy.
examples.transliteration: Ba3dein reg'ou beithom el gamil mabsootein geddan.

examples.arabic: اشتريت الحاجات اللي عايزها ورجعت البيت مبسوطة من الزحمة والجو الجميل
examples.english: I bought the things I wanted and returned home happy with the crowd and the beautiful atmosphere.
examples.transliteration: Eshtarēt el-ḥāgāt elly ʿāyezha we regaʿt el-beit mabsūṭa men ez-zaḥma wel-gaww el-gamīl.
examples.storyTitle: A Trip to the Popular Market

examples.arabic: روحنا نزور عمتي منى في بيتها الجميل
examples.english: We went to visit my Aunt Mona at her beautiful home.
examples.transliteration: Rohna nizor ameti Mona fi bet'ha elgameel

examples.arabic: شفت راجل كبير محترم وقولتله بعد اذنك يا عمو
examples.english: I saw a respectable older man and said to him, 'Excuse me, uncle.'
examples.transliteration: Shoft ragel kibeer mohtaram we oltello ba'd eznek ya 'ammo

examples.arabic: وفي الاخر اكتشفت ان اللي قدامي ده مش احمد اصلا ده توأمه اللي كان عايش بره البلد
examples.english: And in the end, I discovered that the person in front of me wasn't Ahmed at all, but his twin brother who had been living abroad
examples.transliteration: We fel akher ektashaft enn elli oddaami da mesh Ahmed aslan da taw'amo elli kaan 'aayesh barra el balad

examples.arabic: لما روحت البيت اكتشفت ان خالي اصلا عايش في اسوان ومحتاجش جواكت
examples.english: When I went home, I discovered that my uncle actually lives in Aswan and doesn't need jackets.
examples.transliteration: lamma rowwaḥt il-beet iktashaft in khaali aṣlan 3aayish fi Aswan w ma-ḥtaagsh gawaakit

examples.arabic: منى بصّت على أول صفحة كويس وشافت اسم أستاذها مكتوب جوه!
examples.english: Mona looked at the first page carefully and saw her professor's name written inside!
examples.transliteration: Mona basset 'ala awwal safha kwayyes we shafet esm ostazha maktoob gowwa!
examples.storyTitle: The Lost Book on El Moez Street

examples.arabic: البنت بتسأل هو انتي رايحة الشغل دلوقتي
examples.english: The girl asks: Are you going to work now?
examples.transliteration: El-bent betsa'al: Howa enti rayḥa esh-shoġl dilwa'ti?

examples.arabic: البنت عايزة فرح كبير
examples.english: The girl wants a big wedding.
examples.transliteration: El bent ayza farah kibeer

examples.arabic: البنت الصغيرة قالت ايه ده سمك ده مش حلو
examples.english: The little girl said, "What is this? Fish? This is not good!"
examples.transliteration: El bent el soghayyara ʾalet eeh da samak da mush ḥelw.

examples.arabic: الواد صحي الصبح وبيسأل ماما احنا هناكل إيه دلوقتي
examples.english: The boy woke up in the morning and is asking mom, "What are we going to eat now?"
examples.transliteration: Elwaad sehi elsobh webyes'al mama ehna hanaakol eih delwa'ty.

examples.arabic: امبارح، شافوا ست كبيرة شايلة شنط تقيلة كتير.
examples.english: Yesterday, they saw an old lady carrying many heavy bags.
examples.transliteration: Embareh, shafu sett kebira shayla shonat te'eela ketir.

examples.arabic: بياع قال لماما اتفضلي يا ست الكل الفراولة دي بلدي ومسكرة
examples.english: A seller told Mom, "Please, dear lady, these strawberries are local and sweet."
examples.transliteration: Bayya3 2aal le Mama etfaDDali ya sett el-koll el-faraawla di balady we mesakkara

examples.arabic: دخلت المحل والست قالت لي اهلا بيكي
examples.english: I entered the shop and the lady said to me, "Welcome".
examples.transliteration: Dakhalet el-maḥall wel-sett qalet-li ahlan beeki.

examples.arabic: احنا بنختار مكان حلو للناس الكتير
examples.english: We are choosing a nice place for many people.
examples.transliteration: Ehna benekhtar makan helw lel-nas el-keteer.

examples.arabic: لازم نختار اكل حلو للناس
examples.english: We must choose nice food for the people.
examples.transliteration: Lazem nekhtar akl helw lel nas.

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا استاذة ايمان فيه ايه مالك شكلك مش تمام كدة النهاردة
examples.english: Good morning, Mrs. Iman, what's wrong? You don't look okay today.
examples.transliteration: Sabah el kheir ya ostaza Iman, fee eh malek shaklek mesh tamam kida el naharda?

examples.arabic: صباح الخير يا جارتي شكلك زعلانة النهاردة
examples.english: Good morning, my neighbor, you look sad today.
examples.transliteration: Sabah el kheer ya garti, shaklek za'lana ennaharda.

examples.arabic: في البيت ده، كان ساكن ولد اسمه كريم.
examples.english: In this house, a boy named Karim lived.
examples.transliteration: Fi el beit da, kan saken walad esmo Karim.
examples.storyTitle: Karim's Ball and the Neighborhood Friends

examples.arabic: انا بشرب شاي الصبح في البيت والولد الصغير دخل عليا
examples.english: I drink tea in the morning at home and the little boy entered to me
examples.transliteration: Ana bashrab shay el sobh fel beit wel walad el soghayar dakhal alaya
examples.storyTitle: The Boy and the Many Questions

examples.english: There was a child named Karim who asked many questions every morning
examples.transliteration: Kan fi tefl esmo Karim biyes'al as'ela kiteer kol yom el sobh

examples.arabic: فيه طفل صغير اسمه كريم
examples.english: There is a small child, his name is Karim.
examples.transliteration: Feh tefl soghayar esmo Karim.

examples.arabic: طفل صغير بيشوف سمكة جديدة في طبق
examples.english: A small child sees a new fish in a dish.
examples.transliteration: Tefl saghir beyshoof samaka gideeda fi tabaq.

examples.arabic: مصطفى: جميل! أنا زرت أصحابي كلهم.
examples.english: Mostafa: Nice! I visited all my friends.
examples.transliteration: Mostafa: Gameel! Ana zort as7aby kolluhom.

examples.arabic: قعدنا نتكلم كتير عن أيامنا القديمة؛ كانت لحظات جميلة وسعيدة مع أصحابي.
examples.english: We sat talking a lot about our old days; they were beautiful and happy moments with my friends.
examples.transliteration: 2a3adna netkallem keteer 3an ayyamna el 2adima; kanet la7azat gameela w sa3eeda ma3 as7abi.

examples.arabic: الظهر، أصحابي خبطوا على الباب وطلبوا مني أخرج.
examples.english: In the afternoon, my friends knocked on the door and asked me to go out.
examples.transliteration: el dohr, ashabiy khabato ala el bab wa talabo meny akhrog.
examples.storyTitle: The Joy of Eid with the Family

examples.arabic: الصحوبية بتبقى أقوى لما بنشارك اللحظات دي مع بعض.
examples.english: Friendship becomes stronger when we share these moments together.
examples.transliteration: El sohobeya beteb'a aqwa lamma bensharek el lahazat di ma'a ba'd.
